Dear Editor,

We submit “Arbitrary-Order Enclosures for the SU(2) Heat-Kernel Action.” The
paper derives computable uniform bounds for every requested finite derivative
order of the central SU(2) heat-kernel action, including a positive
logarithmic floor, separate identity and cut-locus image charts, and a
Haar-normalized tail estimate. An exact-rational order-eight certificate,
independent verifier, and standard-library tests accompany the manuscript.

The heat kernel and heat-kernel lattice action are classical; the contribution
is the explicit arbitrary-order enclosure and certification interface. The
paper makes no continuum Yang--Mills or mass-gap claim.

Sincerely,

The authors
